info.title: QuickFlow API
info.description: Tasks, habits, learning resources, todo plans, settings and dashboard for the QuickFlow personal productivity app.

get.summary:
Returns summary metrics (tasks, habits, plans, learning) and the lists shown on the dashboard:
today's, overdue and completed-today tasks, today's habits, active/upcoming plans and learning in progress.
Lists habits with their progress; filter with `isActive`.
Gets one habit with its progress.

put.summary: Updates a habit's name, description and frequency.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes a habit and its completions.

post.summary: Deactivates a habit (kept, but no longer tracked as active).

get.summary: Lists a habit's completions, newest first.

post.summary: Marks a habit complete for a date (default today). A second completion for the same date returns 409.

delete.summary: Removes the completion of a habit for a date (yyyy-MM-dd).

get.summary: Returns 200 when the API is up and the database is reachable, 503 otherwise.
Lists learning cards (newest first) with milestones and notes; filter by `status`.
Gets one learning card with its milestones and notes.

put.summary: Updates a learning card's title, description and status.

delete.summary: Removes a learning card with its milestones and notes.

post.summary: Adds a milestone to a learning card.

patch.summary: Renames, completes/reopens or re-dates a milestone of this card.

delete.summary: Removes a milestone from this card.

post.summary: Adds a free-form note to a learning card.

delete.summary: Removes a note from this card.

get.summary: Lists plans ordered by priority order (then start time), optionally filtered by computed status.

post.summary: Creates a plan from existing tasks, habits and/or learning resources.

get.summary: History of completed plans (ended or all items done) with how much of each was completed.
Plans whose start time has been reached (and not yet ended) and whose start notification was not acknowledged.

post.summary: Acknowledges a plan's start notification so it is not reported again.

get.summary: Gets one plan with its items and computed progress.

put.summary: Updates a plan's fields and items (retained items keep their done flag).

delete.summary: Removes a plan (its items are removed; the referenced tasks/habits/cards are kept).

patch.summary:
Marks a plan item done or not done. Returns the updated plan (progress recomputed).
The source entity's own completion follows (BR-13): task Done/Todo, habit completion for today, card Completed/InProgress.

put.summary: Updates settings; omitted fields are unchanged.

get.summary: Lists tasks. Archived tasks are excluded unless `archived` says otherwise.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text contained in the title.

parameters.name: DueDate
parameters.description: Only tasks due on this date.

parameters.name: DueFrom
parameters.description: Only tasks due on or after this date.

parameters.name: DueTo
parameters.description: Only tasks due on or before this date.

parameters.name: Overdue
parameters.description: true = only overdue tasks, false = only tasks that are not overdue.

parameters.name: Archived
parameters.description: Exclude (default) hides archived tasks, Include shows all, Only shows archived tasks.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: CreatedAt (default) or DueDate. Tasks without a due date sort last.

put.summary: Updates a task's title, description, status, priority and due date.

post.summary: Marks a task as completed (status Done).
Archives a task (hidden from the default list).

today.description: The server's local date used for "today" and "overdue".

displayName.description: User's display name from settings (for the greeting).

overdueTasks.description: Tasks due before today that are not Done.

habitsToday.description: Active habits with today's completion state.

activePlans.description: In-progress plans with live rest time and progress, by priority order.

DashboardResponse.description: Everything the dashboard shows, computed at `GeneratedAt`.

date.description: Date of the completion (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to today; cannot be in the future.

HabitCompletionResponse.description: A completion event of a habit.

HabitRequest.description: Body for creating or updating a habit.

completedThisPeriod.description: Daily: completed today. Weekly: completed at least once this ISO week (Mon–Sun).

currentStreak.description: Consecutive days (Daily) or weeks (Weekly) with a completion.

HabitResponse.description: A habit with its completion progress as of today.

description.description: Description or source (link, book, course name); at most 2000 characters.

LearningCardRequest.description: Body for creating or updating a learning card.

LearningCardResponse.description: A learning card with its milestones (in creation order) and notes (newest first).

PlanItemRequest.description: Reference to an existing entity to include in a plan.

PlanItemResponse.description: An item of a plan. `SourceTitle` is the current title/name of the referenced entity.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated duration in minutes; required, greater than 0.

startDateTime.description: Start date-time (ISO 8601). Values without an offset are taken as server local time.

endDateTime.description: End date-time; must be after StartDateTime.

priorityOrder.description: Rank relative to other plans (lower = higher priority, ≥ 0). Create default: after the last plan; update default: unchanged.

items.description: At least one existing task, habit or learning resource; no duplicates. On update the list replaces the items (retained items keep IsDone).

PlanRequest.description: Body for creating or updating a plan.

startNotifiedAt.description: When the start notification was acknowledged (null = not yet).

isRestTimeActive.description: True only while the plan is in progress (between start and end, items still open).

restTimeSeconds.description: Seconds remaining until EndDateTime while rest time is active, else null.

secondsUntilStart.description: Seconds until StartDateTime for plans not yet started, else null.

timeElapsedPercentage.description: Elapsed share of the start→end window (0–100).

PlanResponse.description:
A plan with server-computed progress. Status, completion and rest time are computed at
`ServerTime`; clients count rest time down locally from `RestTimeSeconds` or `EndDateTime`.

notificationLeadMinutes.description: Minutes before a plan's start at which to notify (0 = at start).

isOverdue.description: True when the due date is before today and the task is not Done (and not archived).

TaskResponse.description: A task as returned by the API.

isDone.description: true completes the milestone, false reopens it.

UpdateMilestoneRequest.description: Partial update of a milestone; omitted fields are unchanged.

UpdatePlanItemRequest.description: Body for marking a plan item done / not done.

displayName.description: At most 100 characters; cannot be blank when provided.

email.description: Valid email address, at most 200 characters; "" clears it.

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Settings update. Omitted (null) fields keep their current value; an empty email clears it.

UpdateTaskRequest.description:
Body for updating a task. Title is required. Omitted/null Status or Priority keep their
current value; Description and DueDate are replaced (null clears them).
